description: Per product-id ONNX interchange source, IO contract, and license. Dual-file rules and remaining gaps: docs/onnx-interchange.md. HF hosts ONNX (plus CLIP vocab) after all interchange files exist — P2 local files are not uploaded yet. Product conf/model/**/*.toml stay type=mnn or type=tensorrt except diffusion/MSOCRNET/SAM-decoder overlays and LIBFACE (YuNet 2026may type=onnx). Do not reverse MNN/.model/.engine. Bytes/sha256 live in conf/weights_manifest.json. Dual files: {stem}.static_bs1.onnx and {stem}.dyn.onnx.

onnx_status.local: ONNX on disk, not on HF; P1 uploads when p1_upload=true

onnx_status.blocked: no matching official graph, or scaffold; keep runtime weight
